walkthroughWhatDescription: AI coding assistants can read the files you have open in your editor. Clotr checks open files as you edit for credentials and, if you turn the option on, personal details. Each finding is underlined. Your code stays on this computer.
walkthroughTryTitle: Try it with a made-up key
walkthroughTryDescription:
Click Try it to open an unsaved example with a made-up AWS key that starts with AKIA, and see Clotr underline it. The sample stays on this computer. No account or network needed.
[Try it](command:clotr.tryIt)
walkthroughGuardTitle: Check what you send to AI coding assistants
walkthroughGuardDescription:
Clotr Guard checks prompts for assistants it supports, including Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, Windsurf, and Cline where available, before they leave your computer. Pick your assistants, look over the exact change, then apply it. It needs Node.js 20 or newer.
[Set up Clotr Guard](command:clotr.setupGuard)
